scientific_position: This model ranks candidate subsurface-ice investigation zones and feasible landing/traverse concepts. It does not claim confirmed water ice until exact CPR/DOP and official crater AOI validation are supplied.

coordinate_frame.map_projection: lunar south-pole polar stereographic where available
coordinate_frame.dashboard_overlay: normalized viewport coordinates for hackathon demo layers
coordinate_frame.south_indicator: south-pole product view; south/up orientation is retained where source browse uses it

scale_model.ohrc_native_resolution_m: sub-meter class source strips; dashboard uses browse/zoom chips until map-projected AOI registration

candidate_sites.rationale: low-slope, higher-accessibility terrain with safer traverse start conditions
radar/cold-trap/accessibility consistency; still requires exact CPR/DOP validation
radar-bright but terrain/morphology riskier; useful for showing rough-terrain rejection

prediction_model.output: candidate investigation priority, not confirmed ice probability
prediction_model.current_recommendation: prioritize SCI-B via LZ-A, then confirm with exact CPR/DOP and registered OHRC AOI

downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.name: Official supplied crater AOI
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.exact_request: official hackathon-provided doubly shadowed crater footprint/coordinates/GeoJSON or equivalent
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.why: replaces DSC-1 proxy and anchors all landing/traverse/volume estimates

downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.name: Calibrated CPR/DOP or MIDAS outputs
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.exact_request: CPR raster and DOP raster for the supplied DFSAR crater product, or MIDAS/official polarimetric processing output
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.why: turns experimental CPR/DOP proxy into the required radar detection framework

downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.name: Map-projected OHRC AOI product
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.exact_request: OHRC calibrated/map-projected strip overlapping the supplied crater AOI, plus geometry/label files
downloads_or_inputs_still_needed.why: enables final boulder/crater hazard certification instead of browse-scale hazard proxy
